draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Granite Studio's setup
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for the update -- glad Wrenfield is landing well so far, and that getting the rest of the team in is the next step.

A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, which may be easier for the whole studio at once.

On your open SSO question, Tariq has that one and will follow up. For reference, SSO is available on the Team plan.

Happy to walk through adding the team with you on a short call this week if that helps.

Best,
Nadia
